claims.claim: SentinelOne expanded a multi-year Google Cloud collaboration covering EDR, AI-app/agent security, threat intelligence and data-sovereignty deployments across North America, Frankfurt and Saudi Arabia.
SentinelOne also expanded on-premise/self-hosted/air-gapped AI security and announced an Amazon Bedrock AgentCore integration, broadening coverage for regulated and agentic environments.

factors.name: AI security surface expansion
factors.basis: Primary announcements show product expansion across AI data, runtime, agents and sovereign/on-premise environments.

factors.name: ecosystem leverage
factors.basis: Google Cloud and AWS integrations can extend distribution and telemetry reach.

risks.risk: Partnership breadth and product announcements do not by themselves prove durable monetization or competitive win rates.

unknowns.unknown: Incremental ARR attributable specifically to newer AI-security modules is not established by these releases.

claims.claim: Fiscal 2026 revenue exceeded $1B and grew 22% year over year; ARR grew 22%, while management reported full-year operating profitability.
SentinelOne said it protects nearly one-fifth of the Fortune 500, indicating material enterprise penetration while it expands into adjacent AI-security categories.

factors.name: scale conversion
factors.basis: Revenue/ARR growth and operating-profitability progress provide execution evidence beyond product narrative.

factors.name: competitive intensity
factors.basis: Endpoint, cloud, SIEM and AI security remain crowded with large incumbent and specialist competitors.

risks.risk: Rapid category expansion can raise execution and integration complexity even as platform breadth improves.

unknowns.unknown: Scout does not infer current valuation or post-March financial performance without a fresher canonical financial source.
